workflows.description: Review, list, read, compare, table, or summarise ordinary mailbox messages through mail tools without treating the request as paper ingestion or represented-knowledge authoring.
workflows.content: Execution workflow for broad mail review tasks: list recent messages, read selected messages, inspect labels, sender, date, subject, snippets and body evidence, and answer with the requested list, table, summary, comparison, triage, or bounded follow-up. This workflow is for mail as mail. It may surface conditional follow-on affordances when message evidence suggests arXiv ingestion, scholarly paper representation, meeting extraction, task creation, Jira follow-up, or Vontology writes, but it must not perform those follow-ons unless the user explicitly asks for that authoring or ingestion objective.

input_mappings.description: Original user request for mail review.
Mail profile or account named by the request or context.
Bounded message count requested for the review.
Grounded mail-search query or scope phrase carried from selector decision.
Mailbox label or category filter explicitly supplied by the request.
Requested output shape such as table, list, digest, summary, or comparison.
Requested fields for each message row or item.

llm_policy.response_contract_text: Resolve the Gmail/mail profile from represented Vontology resource facts before any mail tool is called. Use the authenticated user concept from user_concept_id, user_id, or the user part of namespace. Inspect relationships from that user with predicates #V#has_authorised_mail_profile and #V#has_default_mail_profile, then fetch any candidate profile concepts you need. Select a profile only when it is represented for the user and either explicitly named by the request, marked as default, or the only authorised mail profile. Do not use environment defaults, tool defaults, or unrepresented profile strings. Return JSON only with keys mail_profile_resolution_status, mail_review_profile_id, mail_profile_resource_concept_id, mail_profile_candidates, and mail_profile_resolution_reason. Set mail_review_profile_id to the runtime_profile_alias attribute or alias concept value such as vonwitbrock-gmail, not the #V# concept id. If no represented profile is available or multiple profiles remain ambiguous, set mail_profile_resolution_status to needs_user_choice, set mail_review_profile_id to null, include candidates if known, and do not call Gmail tools.
